summary: A 6 x 4 m outdoor event stage, 1 m high: twelve 2 x 1 m aluminium-framed stage decks with black anti-slip ply… joints truss_front_tilt_0, truss_front_tilt_1, truss_front_tilt_2, truss_front_tilt_3, truss_back_tilt_0, truss_back_tilt_1, …; options drape, backdrop, pa; sockets socket_centre_stage, socket_mic, socket_stair_foot.
